attributes.body_ja:
格助詞（かくじょし）の「に」と五段動詞（ごだんどうし）「沿（そ）う」のテ形（けい）を組（く）み合（あ）わせた「に沿（そ）って」は、「(A) の通（とお）りに」や「(A) に合（あ）うように」という意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。この表現（ひょうげん）は主（おも）に、法律（ほうりつ）・慣習（かんしゅう）・伝統（でんとう）・需要（じゅよう）など、ふつうはそれに反（はん）することがないものに関（かん）して使（つか）われます。この文法（ぶんぽう）のニュアンスは、 (A) を基準（きじゅん）として、(B) をそれに合（あ）わせて行（おこな）うというものです。

「に沿（そ）って」が名詞（めいし）を修飾（しゅうしょく）する場合（ばあい）は、動詞（どうし）の形（かたち）は「沿（そ）う」や「沿（そ）った」のように普通形（ふつうけい）になります。

「沿（そ）う」の基本的（きほんてき）な意味（いみ）は「基準（きじゅん）となるものから離（はな）れずについていく」なので、この文法（ぶんぽう）は道（みち）や線（せん）などの長（なが）く続（つづ）いているものに使（つか）われることもよくあります。

この文法（ぶんぽう）は比較的（ひかくてき）フォーマルですが、文字（もじ）通（どお）り「離（はな）れずに進（すす）む」という意味（いみ）であれば、日常的（にちじょうてき）によく使（つか）われています。
attributes.body:
When used with the case marking particle に, the う-Verb 沿（そ）う 'to run alongside' in its て-form expresses that something is going 'along with (A)', 'in accordance with (A)', or 'in line with (A)'. This is primarily in relation to laws, conventions, traditions, needs, and other things which are not usually deviated away from. The nuance with this particular grammar structure is that (A) is the controlling factor, and (B) is being done with that in consideration.

に沿（そ）って may also appear with the verb in its standard form when paired with a second noun, in order to modify that noun.

As the base meaning of 沿（そ）う is 'to follow along', it will also regularly be seen in relation to going along some specific path or street.

While this grammar structure is relatively formal, when literally meaning 'alongside', it will be used fairly frequently.

When used to mean in line with or in accordance with, にしたがって and に沿って are similar and often interchangeable, as in 規則（にしたがって／に沿って）行動する (act according to the regulations). However, に沿って can also mean along(side), as in 川に沿って歩く (walk alongside the river), while にしたがって cannot.

attributes.body: に沿って and に応じて can both suggest doing something in line with a standard, but differ in nuance. に沿って means according to, as in 会社の方針に沿って行動する (act according to company policy). に応じて implies acting in response to or suitable for something, as in 客のニーズに応じてサービスを提供する (provide a service suitable for customers’ needs).

attributes.body: に沿って and に伴って・に伴い both imply corresponding relationships, but with different nuances. に沿って means in line with in literal or figurative contexts, as in 点線に沿って (along the dotted line) or スケジュールに沿って (in line with the schedule). に伴って・に伴い suggests one change occurring along with another, as in 人口減少に伴って (along with the declining population).

attributes.body: Both convey doing something in accordance with something else, but differ in nuance. れる・られる + ままに implies doing something exactly as told or forced, with little choice, as in 指示されるがままにやった (I did it exactly as instructed). に沿って simply means in line with a tangible or figurative standard, as in 点線に沿って (along the dotted line) or スケジュールに沿って (in line with the schedule), without implying lack of control.

attributes.body: While both と並んで and に沿って indicate some kind of coordination, their core meanings differ. と並んで highlights equivalence or joint status, e.g. 'ドラえもんと並んで人気のアニメ' ('an anime as popular as Doraemon'). に沿って means 'in line with' or 'according to', emphasizing adherence to a path, rule, or guideline, e.g. '規則に沿って行動する' ('act in accordance with the rules').
